name: The work score
reader_question: What changes across Run, Develop and Govern/change?
visual_idea: Three horizontal scores align context, contribution, review and output without claiming automation or quantities.
why_geometry_helps: Three horizontal scores align context, contribution, review and output without claiming automation or quantities.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: Alignment could imply all tasks have the same review process; review wording differs per route and no automatic action is drawn.
references_used: Supplied Design Board-8: simultaneous source, interpretation and responsibility
Supplied Design System-15: material distinction, authored scale and quiet chrome
what_is_deliberately_not_shown: Detailed chapter text and actual enterprise readiness.
